task: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First step, move west. And then, try to move south. And then, make an attempt to go to the south. With that done, retrieve the American style passkey from the basket. After that, go north. Then, unlock the American style gate in the study. And then, open the American style gate. After that, go to the east. And then, open the gate inside the sauna. After opening the gate, make an attempt to venture east. Then, make an attempt to move east. With that done, try to venture south. After that, pick-up the non-euclidean latchkey from the floor of the spare room. And then, go north. After that, make absolutely sure that the non-euclidean passageway is unlocked. After that, open the non-euclidean passageway. Then, move north. With that over with, move east. After that, make an effort to head south. Then, recover the stapler from the floor of the studio. Got that? Good!
